consequence.statement: After upgrading to 3.0.0, environments running the haproxy shipped with Argo CD get the chart-matching haproxy version instead of the previously shipped one; the evidence states no failure.
consequence.remediation: Verify the chart-matching haproxy version behaves as expected in environments that run the haproxy shipped with Argo CD.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes a version mismatch by updating the haproxy version used with Argo CD to the one used in the chart.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: the changelog line states only that the haproxy version is updated to match the chart; it does not state the previous or the new version value (both required to assert a value change), nor does it state where the version is pinned
